plain_statement.en: 4 is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n) → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p ≤ q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 若一个自然数可写成两个素数之和，则可选取一组使第一个素数不大于第二个。
plain_statement.en: If a natural number is a sum of two primes, it has such a representation with the first prime at most the second.

gaps.statement: ∀ n p q : ℕ, 4 < n → Even n → Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → p + q = n → Odd p ∧ Odd q

plain_statement.zh: 大于 4 的偶数若写成两个素数之和，则这两个素数都是奇数。
plain_statement.en: In any representation of an even natural number greater than 4 as two primes, both primes are odd.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < ((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p))).card ↔ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 对每个自然数 n，满足 p≤n 且 p 和 n−p 均为素数的自然数 p 的个数为正，当且仅当 n 可写成两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: For every natural number n, the count of natural numbers p ≤ n for which p and n − p are prime is positive exactly when n is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 处理自然数减法时保留 p≤n。这个计数把 (3,7) 和 (7,3) 分别计入。
brief.en: Keep p ≤ n when reasoning about natural subtraction. This count includes (3,7) and (7,3) separately.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n) ↔ (∃ p : ℕ, p ≤ n / 2 ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p))

plain_statement.zh: 一个自然数 n 可写成两个素数之和，当且仅当能找到不超过 n 除以 2 向下取整的素数 p，且 n−p 也是素数。
plain_statement.en: A natural number n is a sum of two primes exactly when a prime p at most floor(n/2) exists for which n − p is prime.

brief.zh: 选择较小的加数，再把配对素数写成 n−p。
brief.en: Choose the smaller summand and express the other prime as n − p.

gaps.statement: ∀ n p : ℕ, p ≤ n → Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime (n - p) → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 若自然数 p 不超过 n，且 p 与 n−p 都是素数，则 n 可写成两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: If natural numbers n and p satisfy p ≤ n and both p and n − p are prime, then n is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ a b c : ℕ, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → (∀ n : ℕ, a ≤ n → n < b → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)) → (∀ n : ℕ, b ≤ n → n < c → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)) → ∀ n : ℕ, a ≤ n → n < c → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 对自然数 a≤b≤c，若半开区间 [a,b) 和 [b,c) 内的每个偶数均可写成两个素数之和，则 [a,c) 内的每个偶数也可以。
plain_statement.en: For natural numbers a ≤ b ≤ c, if every even number in each of the half-open intervals [a,b) and [b,c) is a sum of two primes, then so is every even number in [a,c).

gaps.statement: ∀ a b c : ℕ, a ≤ b → b + 2 ≤ c → Even b → (∀ n : ℕ, a ≤ n → n ≤ b → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)) → (∀ n : ℕ, b + 2 ≤ n → n ≤ c → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)) → ∀ n : ℕ, a ≤ n → n ≤ c → Even n → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 设自然数 a≤b、b+2≤c 且 b 为偶数。若闭区间 [a,b] 与 [b+2,c] 内的每个偶数都可写成两个素数之和，则闭区间 [a,c] 内的每个偶数也可以。
plain_statement.en: Let natural numbers a, b and c satisfy a ≤ b and b + 2 ≤ c, with b even. If every even number in the closed intervals [a,b] and [b+2,c] is a sum of two primes, so is every even number in [a,c].

brief.zh: 两段之间唯一缺少的整数 b+1 是奇数。这就是闭区间分块可以拼接的原因。
brief.en: The only integer between the two blocks is b + 1, which is odd. This fact allows adjacent closed even blocks to compose.

plain_statement.en: Every even natural number in the closed interval [924, 930] is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ a x b : ℝ, 2 ≤ a → a ≤ x → x < b → b - a ≤ 123 * (Real.log a) ^ 2 → x < b ∧ b ≤ x + 123 * (Real.log x) ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 对实数 2≤a≤x<b，若 b−a≤123(log a)²，则 b 落在 (x,x+123(log x)²] 内。
plain_statement.en: For real numbers 2 ≤ a ≤ x < b, if b − a ≤ 123(log a)², then b belongs to (x,x+123(log x)²].

brief.zh: 在 [2,∞) 上比较非负对数的平方，再比较区间右端点。
brief.en: Compare squares of nonnegative logarithms on [2,∞), then compare the right endpoints.

gaps.statement: (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2

plain_statement.zh: 自然对数 log 2 至少为 2/3。
plain_statement.en: The natural logarithm of 2 is at least 2/3.

brief.zh: 这个显式下界可用于证明有限短区间样例的间距预算。
brief.en: This explicit bound supplies the gap budget for the finite short-interval pilot.

gaps.statement: (2 / 3 : ℝ) ≤ Real.log 2 → ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ 1000 → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Odd p ∧ Odd q ∧ x < ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x + 123 * (Real.log x) ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 若 log 2≥2/3，则对每个闭区间 [2,1000] 内的实数 x，开左闭右区间 (x,x+123(log x)²] 内至少有一个数是两个奇素数之和。
plain_statement.en: Assuming log 2 ≥ 2/3, for every real x in [2,1000] the interval (x,x+123(log x)²] contains a sum of two odd primes.

brief.zh: 用 32 和 1002 分成两段，在 x=32 时用较大的见证。
brief.en: Use 32 and 1002 to split the proof. Choose the larger witness when x = 32.

gaps.statement: ∀ (g : ℕ → ℕ) (k : ℕ) (X : ℝ), g 0 = 2 → X < (g k : ℝ) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < k → g i < g (i + 1)) → (∀ i : ℕ, i < k → (g (i + 1) : ℝ) - (g i : ℝ) ≤ 123 * (Real.log (g i : ℝ)) ^ 2) → (∀ i : ℕ, 0 < i → i ≤ k → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Odd p ∧ Odd q ∧ p + q = g i) → ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → x ≤ X → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Odd p ∧ Odd q ∧ x < ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ∧ ((p + q : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ x + 123 * (Real.log x) ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 设 k 为自然数、X 为实数，序列 g₀,…,gₖ 严格递增，g₀=2、gₖ>X。若每个 i<k 满足 gᵢ₊₁−gᵢ≤123(log gᵢ)²，且每个 1≤i≤k 的 gᵢ 都是两个奇素数之和，则对每个实数 x∈[2,X]，区间 (x,x+123(log x)²] 内存在两个奇素数之和。
plain_statement.en: Let k be natural and X real, with a strictly increasing natural-number sequence g₀,…,gₖ satisfying g₀ = 2 and gₖ > X. Suppose each step i < k is at most 123(log gᵢ)² and each gᵢ with 1 ≤ i ≤ k is a sum of two odd primes. Then (x,x+123(log x)²] contains such a sum for every real x in [2,X].

brief.zh: 取最小的 i 使 gᵢ>x。它不是 0，且前一项不超过 x。
brief.en: Take the first i with gᵢ > x. It is nonzero and its predecessor is at most x.

gaps.statement: ∀ X : ℕ, ((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ n % 2 = 0 ∧ ((Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p))).card = 0)).card = 0 ↔ (∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → n ≤ X → n % 2 = 0 → (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n))

plain_statement.zh: 对每个自然数 X，若按 p≤n 且 p、n−p 均为素数来计数，则 [4,X] 内表示数为零的偶数有零个，当且仅当该区间内每个偶数都是两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: For every natural number X, count representations by the number of p ≤ n such that p and n − p are prime. The number of even n in [4,X] with zero representations is zero exactly when every even number in [4,X] is a sum of two primes.

gaps.statement: ∀ (I F : Finset ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), F ⊆ I → 0 < B → (∀ n ∈ F, B ≤ |e n|) → (F.card : ℝ) * B ^ 2 ≤ Finset.sum I (fun n => |e n| ^ 2)

plain_statement.zh: 设 F⊆I 为有限自然数集合、e 为实值函数且 B>0。若 F 中每个 n 均满足 |e(n)|≥B，则 |F|·B² 不超过 I 上的误差平方和。
plain_statement.en: Let F ⊆ I be finite sets of natural numbers, e a real-valued function, and B > 0. If |e(n)| ≥ B for every n in F, then the cardinality of F times B² is at most the sum of squared errors over I.

brief.zh: 先在 F 上逐项比较，再利用平方项非负把求和范围扩大到 I。
brief.en: First compare summands on F, then use nonnegativity of squares to enlarge the sum to I.

gaps.statement: ∀ (I F : Finset ℕ) (e : ℕ → ℝ) (B : ℝ), F ⊆ I → 0 < B → (∀ n ∈ F, B ≤ |e n|) → Finset.sum I (fun n => |e n| ^ 2) < B ^ 2 → F = ∅

plain_statement.zh: 设 F⊆I 为有限自然数集合、e 为实值函数且 B>0。若 F 中每个 n 均满足 |e(n)|≥B，而 I 上的误差平方和严格小于 B²，则 F 为空集。
plain_statement.en: Let F ⊆ I be finite sets of natural numbers, e a real-valued function, and B > 0. If |e(n)| ≥ B for every n in F and the sum of squared errors over I is strictly less than B², then F is empty.

brief.zh: 若 F 里有一项，其平方已用完至少 B² 的误差预算。
brief.en: If F contains one point, its square alone uses at least B² of the error budget.
